title: 선주상호보험조합법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:9:0:00009:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 9 (Record Content of the Balance Sheet)
(1) In accordance with Article 45(3) of the Act, the association shall record the assets, liabilities, and capital of the association in the balance sheet, categorized by major items, and the liabilities shall include the provisions for liabilities and emergency risk reserves as stipulated in Article 8(1) and Article 2 of the same article.
(2) The specific content of the items recorded in Article 1 shall be in accordance with the provisions determined by the Minister of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries. <Amended March 24, 2013>
